Semantic summary: a battle/overlay particle-field effect (retained assembly already names it RunParticleFieldEffect; kept as the registered name in games/gs1/source-paths.json, the working C symbol stays Func_080db6e0 for candidate-show tooling). Two arguments: an object pointer republished at work+0x7828, and a variant selector. variant==1 procedurally builds a 64-entry grayscale BG palette ramp and forces mode=1; other variants load a palette resource via Func_08002f40 and take the runtime mode from the object's offset 24. Seeds a 32-entry 'near' particle array at work+0x7080 and a 1024-entry 'far' particle array at the fixed EWRAM buffer 0x02010000 (both stride 0x1C, masked-RNG velocity/position fields, status word driven by the object's own field-4 flag). Registers a single kind-46 rectangle-blit callback and runs a per-frame while loop, bounded and gated by a 3-bytes-per-mode lookup table at 0x080eeae2 ([far_active_count, near_active_count, total_frames]): each frame projects and draws up to far_active_count far particles through a depth-bucketed sprite table (Data_080ede48), progressively reveals near particles (index < frame) through a growth-animated sprite pair (Data_080eeaec/Data_080eeafa) for their first 20 frames, cues one or two per-member sound effects on a flat frame==member_index+6 trigger, and tears the callback/palette-kind down at the end.

The 'wrong' class and the 476/373 residual are entirely register-allocation/frame-layout: candidate-show's aligned comparison shows zero opcode mismatches anywhere in the function. The dominant, already cross-family-documented open question (games/gs1/recon/en/main/080d59b0.json's own notes describe the identical phenomenon on a sibling in this same 0x03001eec family) is that the reference keeps `work` in sl for the whole function; this compiler keeps choosing r9 for it here instead, which frees sl for other uses (this owner's particle-loop pointer) and in turn changes which values get spilled to stack at the two DrawRectangleFn call sites -- both sides spill canvas+draw_rectangle there, just at stack offsets shifted by the resulting frame-size gap (48 vs the reference's 56, an 8-12 byte gap depending on measurement point). 080d59b0.json already tried and rejected declaration-order/scope permutation for exactly this fp/r9-class choice on a sibling owner sharing the identical work-block idiom; that finding is treated as controlling here rather than re-run, per CONTRIBUTING.md's ban on forcing register assignment or open-ended permutation search once the residual is confirmed register-class-only.

No GS2 or external source, no other Golden Sun decompilation project, and no gsret disassembly were consulted. Only this repository's own retained assembly, approved ROM, adopted exact sources, in-repo headers, and approved compiler were used.
